jurisdiction_name: GROVE CITY COUNCIL WARD 2 (GROVE CITY-CITY City)
narrative: Grove City Council Ward 2 (City of Grove City-city) has 5,832 registered voters, with 54.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 26.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 18.9%, a clear Republican lean of 7.9 percentage points.
